title: EEG, ECG and pupil data from young and older adults: rest and auditory cued reaction time tasks
description: This dataset contains synchronized EEG, ECG and pupil recordings from 36 young and 39 older adults performing auditory cued reaction time tasks, plus a passive listening condition. The active tasks were a cued simple reaction time task and a cued go/no-go task, and they allow investigation of age-related differences in cortical, autonomic and pupillary responses during anticipation and perceptual decision-making.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 64-channel Neuroscan system at 500 Hz, with electrode positions digitized in 3D and vertical and horizontal EOG and bipolar chest ECG recorded. Pupil data were acquired with an SMI iView X Hi-Speed 1250 system at 240 Hz and merged into the EEGLAB files with the EYE-EEG plugin. Participants completed a 4-minute passive listening task followed by two 8-minute runs of each active task (120 trials per task) using pure-tone auditory cues and targets.
